tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App window background, behind everything. Ink and muted ink read on it in both themes.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default panel, sidebar and input background. Body copy (`ink`, `ink-muted`) reads on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards inside panels, table row hover, menus. `ink` and `ink-muted` read on it.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active nav item, progress track, popovers. `ink` and `ink-muted` read on it.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimmed backdrop behind dialogs and command palettes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: panel borders, dividers, table rules. Never the only cue that a control exists.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of interactive controls (inputs, secondary buttons, toggle tracks). 3:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-overlay`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, captions on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled text on `surface` and `surface-raised`. Still 4.5:1 there.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Fill colour for primary buttons, toggle-on tracks, progress start and the signal gradient. Put `on-accent` text on it; do not use as text.

tokens.name: magenta
tokens.usage: Fill colour for the secondary accent: live or AI activity, selection highlights, progress end of the signal gradient. Put `on-accent` text on it.

tokens.name: cyan-ink
tokens.usage: Cyan as text, icon, link, focus ring and border on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-overlay`. 4.5:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: magenta-ink
tokens.usage: Magenta as text, icon and border on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-overlay`. 4.5:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: cyan-tint
tokens.usage: Background wash behind cyan badges, info alerts and hovered ghost buttons. Text on it is `cyan-ink` or `ink`.

tokens.name: magenta-tint
tokens.usage: Background wash behind magenta badges and live-state alerts. Text on it is `magenta-ink` or `ink`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `cyan` and `magenta` fills. 6:1 or better on both fills in both themes.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus outline, offset 2px, on every interactive element. 3:1 or better on all surfaces.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text, icon and border on surfaces. Always pair with the word or a check glyph, never colour alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text, icon and border on surfaces. Always pair with a word or a ! glyph.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error and destructive text, icon and border on surfaces. Always pair with a word or an x glyph. Lighter than `success` in dark, darker in light, so the pair also differs in lightness.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Splash, empty-state and onboarding headlines. Set uppercase.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Window and page titles. Set uppercase.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside a window. Sentence case.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Panel titles, table headers, button text, tab text, badges. Set uppercase.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, dialog titles, list item primary line.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Files are synced every five minutes.
styles.usage: Default UI and paragraph text. The desktop base size.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Helper text, captions, status bar text.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Code, paths, logs, numeric fields and table figures.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Timestamps, version tags, shortcut hints, dense table cells.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls, list item padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding, compact panel padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default panel padding, gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between panels, section spacing.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Window content margin, large section gaps.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Empty-state and splash vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, table selection outline.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, toggles, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs, alerts.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toggle thumbs, progress bars, status dots.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact button and badge height.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, input, select and tab height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary call-to-action and search field height.

tokens.name: titlebar
tokens.usage: Custom window title bar height.

tokens.name: statusbar
tokens.usage: Bottom status bar height.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Default sidebar width; collapses to 48px.

tokens.name: glow-cyan
tokens.usage: Hover and focus-within on cyan controls, active nav item. The only glow; never on body text.

tokens.name: glow-magenta
tokens.usage: Hover on magenta controls and the live-activity indicator.

tokens.name: elevation
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs floating above the window.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press and focus transitions.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Tab switches, panel expand, toggle thumb.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Window-level transitions and progress fill.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default easing for every transition. Disable under prefers-reduced-motion.
